Primary request: Create exactly SIXTEEN individually isolated human components in a FOUR COLUMN by FOUR ROW grid, front view. This is a cutout component atlas for skeletal animation, NOT full figures or a pose sheet. Genuine transparent PNG alpha, no background or painted checkerboard.
Identity: lean capable adult male light cavalry scout, expressive weathered face, warm brown shoulder-length hair under a practical open-face dark iron helmet with modest nasal guard and brass edging, no crest. Teal-blue wool collar, supple chestnut brown leather vest over ivory linen, restrained brass crown clasp, teal-blue riding cloak with a single subtle gold crown on its OUTER back only, thin gold hem. Warm brown leather forearm bracers, fingerless leather gloves, fitted earth-olive riding breeches, worn brown riding boots with restrained iron buckles. Refined natural proportions, finely sculpted believable materials, premium modern historical-fantasy game render, warm upper-left light with soft cool fill, crisp silhouettes without black cartoon outlines.
Camera: true FRONT view toward the viewer, orthographic camera elevated20degrees. Each part independently depicts its actual front surface, not a three-quarter view. Anatomical left is the person's own left (screen-right when assembled). The head shows a face. The feet point toward the viewer. Front inner cloak has NO crown on it.
Exact order with wide clear transparent gutters:
Row1: complete helmeted head with short neck only / sleeveless torso from neck to belt NO head NO arms NO bare skin circles in sleeve holes; sleeve sockets lined in ivory cloth or dark fabric / separate belt-and-hip riding tunic skirt to upper thigh only NO legs / separate whole short riding cloak from neck to upper thigh, inner surface, no body.
Row2: LEFT upper arm shoulder TOP elbow BOTTOM, ivory sleeve and light leather shoulder panel / RIGHT upper arm / LEFT forearm elbow TOP wrist BOTTOM, leather bracer NO hand / RIGHT forearm.
Row3: LEFT hand wrist TOP fingers BOTTOM, fingerless glove and relaxed fingers curled around an EMPTY invisible vertical handle / RIGHT hand same neutral empty grip, truly opposite anatomical hand / ONE LEFT thigh hip TOP knee BOTTOM, fitted olive riding fabric / ONE RIGHT thigh.
Row4: LEFT shin knee TOP ankle BOTTOM, fitted dark riding gaiter NO foot / RIGHT shin / LEFT separate riding boot ankle opening TOP toes toward camera / RIGHT boot.
Constraints: shoulder-to-elbow, elbow-to-wrist, hip-to-knee and knee-to-ankle axes straight DOWN, rounded overlapping caps with intact fabric; no bent or posed limbs. Hands correctly handed, visible thumb/finger grip opening for placing a separate shaft, no open flat palm. Components separate human rider ONLY: NO horse, saddle, stirrups, spear, shield, reins, weapon or tool. No cape attached to torso. All16complete parts fit their own cells. No text, labels, lines, floor or shadow discs. Actual transparent cutouts, not components painted on an opaque background.
horseFront:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Crownforge Crown Scout horse modular skeletal animation atlas.
Primary request: EXACTLY TWENTY independently isolated horse components in a FOUR COLUMN by FIVE ROW grid. True FRONT view of one handsome chestnut light cavalry horse, orthographic camera20degrees above eye level facing directly toward the viewer. This is an anatomical game-rig parts library, NOT a whole horse, not multiple horses, not poses. Every component isolated, generously padded and centered in its cell. Genuine transparent PNG alpha, no background and no painted checkerboard.
Identity/material: refined athletic chestnut horse with warm copper-brown coat, subtle muscle definition, dark brown mane/tail, narrow pale facial blaze, discreet pale fetlock markings, dark polished hooves. Chestnut brown leather bridle with tasteful small brass fittings, no reins baked onto head. Separate brown leather saddle over teal-blue wool saddlecloth with narrow old-gold piping and small crown embroidery, practical light cavalry tack. New premium realistic sculpted historical-fantasy game art, warm upper-left key light and cool fill, tactile short coat, individual mane strands, supple stitched leather and woven cloth, no black outlines. No rider or human parts.
Camera and anatomy: every piece FRONT-facing. The horse muzzle points toward camera; two eyes and nostrils symmetric in front. Torso/barrel is a narrow deep chest/front barrel surface, NOT broad horse side profile. Hooves show their FRONT toe walls. Left/right always HORSE anatomical sides, never screen labels. Limb segments point straight DOWN, proximal joint TOP and distal joint BOTTOM, with rounded overlapping hide-covered ends, no gore.
Required20slots, exactly:
Row1: (0) HEAD ONLY, ears/poll at TOP, muzzle at BOTTOM, narrow white blaze, leather bridle but NO neck / (1) NECK ONLY from withers attachment at BOTTOM to poll attachment at TOP, thick lower end tapering upward, no head or mane / (2) BARREL torso ONLY, shoulders/chest and rump volume, with ALL neck/head/legs/tail/saddle/mane REMOVED; front-facing deep chest, bare chestnut hide, no saddlecloth / (3) TAIL ONLY, root at TOP dark flowing tail downwards.
Row2: (4) LEFT FRONT upper leg shoulder TOP carpal knee BOTTOM / (5) RIGHT FRONT upper leg / (6) LEFT HIND upper leg hip TOP stifle BOTTOM, fuller muscular thigh / (7) RIGHT HIND upper leg.
Row3: (8) LEFT FRONT lower leg carpal knee TOP fetlock BOTTOM, NO hoof / (9) RIGHT FRONT lower leg / (10) LEFT HIND shank stifle TOP hock BOTTOM, NO cannon or hoof / (11) RIGHT HIND shank.
Row4: (12) LEFT HIND cannon hock TOP fetlock BOTTOM, thin bony section NO hoof / (13) RIGHT HIND cannon / (14) LEFT FRONT HOOF ONLY, short fetlock at TOP dark hoof at BOTTOM / (15) RIGHT FRONT HOOF ONLY.
Row5: (16) LEFT HIND HOOF ONLY / (17) RIGHT HIND HOOF ONLY / (18) MANE ONLY, long narrow dark-brown neck hair strip, poll TOP withers BOTTOM, no head or neck / (19) SADDLE AND SADDLECLOTH ONLY as one assembly, true FRONT view, no horse, no rider, no bridle, no long stirrup straps or hanging reins.
Every slot must be one complete separate part. No extra limbs in body, no full leg in a shank/cannon slot. Consistent natural horse anatomy and genuinely front-on surfaces. No shadows outside components, labels, numbering, grid lines, scenery, full assembled animal, human, weapons. Actual alpha-transparent background throughout all gaps.
